title: AI use-case governance record
description: One AI use case at .ai-governance/use-cases/<id>.json: the questionnaire answers, the tier they produced under a specific policy version, the status and evidence of every required control, approver sign-offs and the re-certification dates. `aipg record new` creates one; `aipg check` re-classifies it against the effective policy and fails until it is complete. Empty strings mean 'not provided yet'.

id.description: Stable identifier. The file is named <id>.json.

owner.description: Accountable owner of the use case (GOV-01).

policy_id.description: policy_id of the policy the use case was certified against.

policy_version.description: Version of that policy at the last certification.

tier.description: Tier ID the answers produced at the last certification.

last_certified.description: Date of the last gate review that classified the use case against the policy.

recertify_by.description: Latest date for the next re-certification (GOV-02): at most the tier's recertification_months after last_certified. Null only for tiers without a cadence.

answers.description: Questionnaire answers keyed by the policy's question IDs.

approvals.description: One sign-off per approver role the tier requires (GOV-03).

role.description: An approver role from the policy tier.

controls.description: Every control the policy requires for these answers, with its status.

name.description: Control name, for readers of the record.

evidence_url.description: Link to the evidence the policy names for this control. Required when status is done.

approver.description: Who approved the waiver. Required when status is waived.

reason.description: Why the control is waived. Required when status is waived.
